notes.title: December update and minor fixes.
notes.content:
We made hew fixes from game saves.
In the previous game version, maybe some levels that do not save correctly.

For everyone, they want some innovation or something to change. Write, all your wishes are important to me. I made the game for you ;).

notes.title: Krakout Christmas is already here
notes.content:
We are very glad you are playing our game. So we prepared a gift for you for Christmas.
First of all, your requests:
Players asked us to do mouse control so you could control the racket without pointing it with the mouse cursor. Now the mouse control has become much more convenient, so be sure to try it.

And now the funniest part ːsteamhappyː.
The game has to be not only challenging but also fun. We see that it’s hard to start a game with three lives and save or earn them during the game. So… start the game with 7 lives now. This way you go further, see more and it will definitely be a lot more fun.
A beautiful, fun, warm Christmas to you all !!!
